examples.hanzi: 我的理想是当一名老师。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de lǐxiǎng shì dāng yì míng lǎoshī.
examples.english: My ideal is to become a teacher.

examples.hanzi: 这个计划听起来很理想。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà tīng qǐlai hěn lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: This plan sounds ideal.

examples.hanzi: 我对牛奶过敏，不能喝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì niúnǎi guòmǐn, bù néng hē.
examples.english: I'm allergic to milk and can't drink it.

examples.hanzi: 春天一到，他就容易过敏。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān yí dào, tā jiù róngyì guòmǐn.
examples.english: As soon as spring comes, he gets allergies easily.

examples.hanzi: 凯特每天坐地铁上班。
examples.pinyin: Kǎitè měitiān zuò dìtiě shàngbān.
examples.english: Kate takes the subway to work every day.

examples.hanzi: 凯特请我们周末去她家吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Kǎitè qǐng wǒmen zhōumò qù tā jiā chīfàn.
examples.english: Kate invited us to her house for dinner this weekend.

examples.hanzi: 他脑子里总是有很多好点子。
examples.pinyin: Tā nǎozi lǐ zǒngshì yǒu hěn duō hǎo diǎnzi.
examples.english: He always has lots of good ideas in his head.

examples.hanzi: 你有什么点子吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme diǎnzi ma?
examples.english: Do you have any ideas?

examples.hanzi: 科技改变了我们的生活。
examples.pinyin: Kējì gǎibiàn le wǒmen de shēnghuó.
examples.english: Technology has changed our lives.

examples.hanzi: 这家科技公司在上海。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kējì gōngsī zài Shànghǎi.
examples.english: This tech company is in Shanghai.

examples.hanzi: 请把这个包裹寄到北京。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhège bāoguǒ jì dào Běijīng.
examples.english: Please send this parcel to Beijing.

examples.hanzi: 我在门口收到了一个包裹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài ménkǒu shōudào le yí ge bāoguǒ.
examples.english: I received a package at the door.

examples.hanzi: 他的工资不高，但很稳定。
examples.pinyin: Tā de gōngzī bù gāo, dàn hěn wěndìng.
examples.english: His salary isn't high, but it's stable.

examples.hanzi: 这个月我的工资涨了一点。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yuè wǒ de gōngzī zhǎng le yìdiǎn.
examples.english: My pay went up a little this month.

examples.hanzi: 小狗有一条小小的尾巴。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎogǒu yǒu yì tiáo xiǎoxiǎo de wěiba.
examples.english: The puppy has a tiny tail.

examples.hanzi: 她住在一个小小的村子里。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhù zài yí ge xiǎoxiǎo de cūnzi lǐ.
examples.english: She lives in a tiny village.

examples.hanzi: 那位妇女正在菜市场买菜。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fùnǚ zhèngzài càishìchǎng mǎi cài.
examples.english: That woman is buying groceries at the market.

examples.hanzi: 妇女和儿童可以先上车。
examples.pinyin: Fùnǚ hé értóng kěyǐ xiān shàng chē.
examples.english: Women and children may board first.

examples.hanzi: 这个消息的来源可靠吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi de láiyuán kěkào ma?
examples.english: Is the source of this news reliable?

examples.hanzi: 这种水果的来源是南方。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ de láiyuán shì nánfāng.
examples.english: This kind of fruit originates in the south.

examples.hanzi: 法院已经作出了判决。
examples.pinyin: Fǎyuàn yǐjīng zuòchū le pànjué.
examples.english: The court has already issued its judgment.

examples.hanzi: 他不满意法院的判决。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù mǎnyì fǎyuàn de pànjué.
examples.english: He is not satisfied with the court's ruling.

examples.hanzi: 这条旅游路线要走三天。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lǚyóu lùxiàn yào zǒu sān tiān.
examples.english: This tourist route takes three days.

examples.hanzi: 请按照这条路线走。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng ànzhào zhè tiáo lùxiàn zǒu.
examples.english: Please follow this route.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们坐在地毯上玩积木。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zuò zài dìtǎn shàng wán jīmù.
examples.english: The children are sitting on the carpet playing with blocks.

examples.hanzi: 这块地毯需要洗一洗。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài dìtǎn xūyào xǐ yi xǐ.
examples.english: This rug needs to be washed.

examples.hanzi: 孩子不能总是依靠父母。
examples.pinyin: Háizi bù néng zǒngshì yīkào fùmǔ.
examples.english: Children can't always rely on their parents.

examples.hanzi: 我们要依靠自己的努力。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào yīkào zìjǐ de nǔlì.
examples.english: We have to rely on our own efforts.

examples.hanzi: 别把还能用的东西扔掉。
examples.pinyin: Bié bǎ hái néng yòng de dōngxi rēngdiào.
examples.english: Don't throw away things that are still usable.

examples.hanzi: 我把旧衣服都扔掉了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ jiù yīfu dōu rēngdiào le.
examples.english: I threw away all the old clothes.

examples.hanzi: 海滩上不允许裸体。
examples.pinyin: Hǎitān shàng bù yǔnxǔ luǒtǐ.
examples.english: Nudity is not allowed on the beach.

examples.hanzi: 美术课上，学生们画了一幅裸体素描。
examples.pinyin: Měishù kè shàng, xuéshengmen huà le yì fú luǒtǐ sùmiáo.
examples.english: In art class, the students drew a nude sketch.

examples.hanzi: 这是一个陷阱，不要上当。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge xiànjǐng, búyào shàngdàng.
examples.english: This is a trap; don't fall for it.

examples.hanzi: 他们掉进了对手设下的陷阱。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen diào jìn le duìshǒu shèxià de xiànjǐng.
examples.english: They fell into the trap their opponent set.

examples.hanzi: 老师对每个学生都很公正。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī duì měi ge xuésheng dōu hěn gōngzhèng.
examples.english: The teacher is very fair to every student.

examples.hanzi: 裁判的判断不够公正。
examples.pinyin: Cáipàn de pànduàn bú gòu gōngzhèng.
examples.english: The referee's decision was not fair enough.

examples.hanzi: 等了一个小时，公交车总算来了。
examples.pinyin: Děng le yí ge xiǎoshí, gōngjiāochē zǒngsuàn lái le.
examples.english: After waiting an hour, the bus finally came.

examples.hanzi: 雨总算停了，我们可以出去玩了。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ zǒngsuàn tíng le, wǒmen kěyǐ chūqù wán le.
examples.english: The rain has finally stopped, so we can go out to play.

examples.hanzi: 我真心感谢你的帮助。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhēnxīn gǎnxiè nǐ de bāngzhù.
examples.english: I sincerely thank you for your help.

examples.hanzi: 她对朋友一向很真心。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì péngyou yíxiàng hěn zhēnxīn.
examples.english: She has always been sincere with her friends.

examples.hanzi: 你昨天去哪儿来着？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān qù nǎr láizhe?
examples.english: Where did you go yesterday, again?

examples.hanzi: 他叫什么名字来着？我忘了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiào shénme míngzi láizhe? Wǒ wàng le.
examples.english: What was his name again? I forgot.

examples.hanzi: 这座古老的寺庙吸引了很多游客。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔlǎo de sìmiào xīyǐn le hěn duō yóukè.
examples.english: This ancient temple attracts a lot of tourists.

examples.hanzi: 爷爷给我讲了一个古老的故事。
examples.pinyin: Yéye gěi wǒ jiǎng le yí ge gǔlǎo de gùshi.
examples.english: Grandpa told me an ancient story.

examples.hanzi: 糟糕，情况不妙，我们快走。
examples.pinyin: Zāogāo, qíngkuàng búmiào, wǒmen kuài zǒu.
examples.english: Oh no, things look bad; let's go quickly.

examples.hanzi: 他脸色不妙，是不是病了？
examples.pinyin: Tā liǎnsè búmiào, shì bu shì bìng le?
examples.english: He looks unwell; is he sick?

examples.hanzi: 小虫子会伪装成树叶。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo chóngzi huì wěizhuāng chéng shùyè.
examples.english: Small insects disguise themselves as leaves.

examples.hanzi: 他伪装成客人混进了酒店。
examples.pinyin: Tā wěizhuāng chéng kèrén hùn jìn le jiǔdiàn.
examples.english: He disguised himself as a guest and slipped into the hotel.

examples.hanzi: 今晚的宴会在六点开始。
examples.pinyin: Jīnwǎn de yànhuì zài liù diǎn kāishǐ.
examples.english: Tonight's banquet starts at six.

examples.hanzi: 我们受邀参加了他们的婚礼宴会。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shòuyāo cānjiā le tāmen de hūnlǐ yànhuì.
examples.english: We were invited to their wedding banquet.

examples.hanzi: 我委托朋友帮我取包裹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wěituō péngyou bāng wǒ qǔ bāoguǒ.
examples.english: I asked a friend to pick up my parcel for me.

examples.hanzi: 这件事已经委托给专业公司了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yǐjīng wěituō gěi zhuānyè gōngsī le.
examples.english: This matter has already been entrusted to a professional company.

examples.hanzi: 很多游客来白宫参观。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō yóukè lái Báigōng cānguān.
examples.english: Many tourists come to visit the White House.

examples.hanzi: 新闻里说白宫发表了声明。
examples.pinyin: Xīnwén lǐ shuō Báigōng fābiǎo le shēngmíng.
examples.english: The news says the White House issued a statement.

examples.hanzi: 我已经把邮件发送给你了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ yóujiàn fāsòng gěi nǐ le.
examples.english: I've already sent the email to you.

examples.hanzi: 信息发送失败，请再试一次。
examples.pinyin: Xìnxī fāsòng shībài, qǐng zài shì yí cì.
examples.english: The message failed to send; please try again.

examples.hanzi: 两个孩子因为玩具起了冲突。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge háizi yīnwèi wánjù qǐ le chōngtū.
examples.english: The two children had a conflict over a toy.

examples.hanzi: 这次会议和我的课时间冲突了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì hé wǒ de kè shíjiān chōngtū le.
examples.english: This meeting conflicts with my class time.

examples.hanzi: 医生给了我一些饮食指示。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng gěi le wǒ yìxiē yǐnshí zhǐshì.
examples.english: The doctor gave me some dietary instructions.

examples.hanzi: 箭头指示出口在右边。
examples.pinyin: Jiàntóu zhǐshì chūkǒu zài yòubiān.
examples.english: The arrow indicates that the exit is on the right.

examples.hanzi: 手机没电了，我只好走路回家。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī méi diàn le, wǒ zhǐhǎo zǒulù huí jiā.
examples.english: My phone ran out of battery, so I had to walk home.

examples.hanzi: 他不在家，我只好改天再来。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú zài jiā, wǒ zhǐhǎo gǎitiān zài lái.
examples.english: He isn't home, so I'll have to come again another day.

examples.hanzi: 我每天早上都去河边散步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang dōu qù hébiān sànbù.
examples.english: I go for a walk by the river every morning.

examples.hanzi: 我们一边散步，一边聊天。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìbiān sànbù, yìbiān liáotiān.
examples.english: We chatted while taking a walk.

examples.hanzi: 她出门前总要化妆。
examples.pinyin: Tā chūmén qián zǒngyào huàzhuāng.
examples.english: She always puts on makeup before going out.

examples.hanzi: 演员在后台化妆。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnyuán zài hòutái huàzhuāng.
examples.english: The actor is putting on makeup backstage.

examples.hanzi: 别提了，我今天又迟到了。
examples.pinyin: Biétí le, wǒ jīntiān yòu chídào le.
examples.english: Don't even mention it; I was late again today.

examples.hanzi: 这次考试题目很难，别提有多紧张了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì tímù hěn nán, biétí yǒu duō jǐnzhāng le.
examples.english: The exam questions were hard, and I can't tell you how nervous I was.

examples.hanzi: 我上午有课，下午有空。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shàngwǔ yǒu kè, xiàwǔ yǒu kòng.
examples.english: I have class in the morning and am free in the afternoon.

examples.hanzi: 他每天上午都在办公室工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān shàngwǔ dōu zài bàngōngshì gōngzuò.
examples.english: He works at the office every morning.

examples.hanzi: 我们昨晚去剧院看了一场话剧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zuówǎn qù jùyuàn kàn le yì chǎng huàjù.
examples.english: We went to the theater last night to see a play.

examples.hanzi: 这家剧院的票很难买。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā jùyuàn de piào hěn nán mǎi.
examples.english: Tickets for this theater are hard to buy.

examples.hanzi: 他用卑鄙的手段赢了比赛。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng bēibǐ de shǒuduàn yíng le bǐsài.
examples.english: He won the game by despicable means.

examples.hanzi: 骗老人的钱是很卑鄙的行为。
examples.pinyin: Piàn lǎorén de qián shì hěn bēibǐ de xíngwéi.
examples.english: Cheating old people out of money is despicable behavior.

examples.hanzi: 我很怀念大学时的生活。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn huáiniàn dàxué shí de shēnghuó.
examples.english: I miss my life in college.

examples.hanzi: 出国以后，他常常怀念家乡的饭菜。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó yǐhòu, tā chángcháng huáiniàn jiāxiāng de fàncài.
examples.english: After going abroad, he often misses the food from home.

examples.hanzi: 我们应该学会宽恕别人的错误。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi xuéhuì kuānshù biéren de cuòwù.
examples.english: We should learn to forgive other people's mistakes.

examples.hanzi: 他请求妈妈宽恕他。
examples.pinyin: Tā qǐngqiú māma kuānshù tā.
examples.english: He asked his mother to forgive him.

examples.hanzi: 我原本打算今天去，结果下雨了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yuánběn dǎsuàn jīntiān qù, jiéguǒ xià yǔ le.
examples.english: I originally planned to go today, but it rained.

examples.hanzi: 这本书原本是写给孩子看的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yuánběn shì xiě gěi háizi kàn de.
examples.english: This book was originally written for children.

examples.hanzi: 我想去国外见识一下不同的文化。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù guówài jiànshi yíxià bùtóng de wénhuà.
examples.english: I want to go abroad and experience different cultures.

examples.hanzi: 他是个有见识的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì ge yǒu jiànshi de rén.
examples.english: He's a person of knowledge and experience.

examples.hanzi: 我们不能原谅他的所作所为。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng yuánliàng tā de suǒzuòsuǒwéi.
examples.english: We can't forgive his conduct.

examples.hanzi: 大家会看到你的所作所为。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā huì kàn dào nǐ de suǒzuòsuǒwéi.
examples.english: Everyone will see what you do.

examples.hanzi: 这个广告很有创意。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guǎnggào hěn yǒu chuàngyì.
examples.english: This advertisement is very creative.

examples.hanzi: 她的创意让大家眼前一亮。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chuàngyì ràng dàjiā yǎnqián yí liàng.
examples.english: Her idea made everyone's eyes light up.

examples.hanzi: 我想用蜂蜜代替糖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yòng fēngmì dàitì táng.
examples.english: I'd like to use honey in place of sugar.

examples.hanzi: 今天老师生病了，由另一位老师代替他。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān lǎoshī shēngbìng le, yóu lìng yí wèi lǎoshī dàitì tā.
examples.english: The teacher is sick today, so another teacher is taking his place.

examples.hanzi: 会上有很多专业人士发言。
examples.pinyin: Huì shàng yǒu hěn duō zhuānyè rénshì fāyán.
examples.english: Many professionals spoke at the meeting.

examples.hanzi: 这位人士不愿透露姓名。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi rénshì bú yuàn tòulù xìngmíng.
examples.english: This person is unwilling to reveal his name.

examples.hanzi: 你干脆告诉他真相吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gāncuì gàosu tā zhēnxiàng ba.
examples.english: You might as well just tell him the truth.

examples.hanzi: 他说话很干脆，从不拖泥带水。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn gāncuì, cóng bù tuōnídàishuǐ.
examples.english: He speaks bluntly and never beats around the bush.

examples.hanzi: 小鸟的身体很脆弱。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo niǎo de shēntǐ hěn cuìruò.
examples.english: A little bird's body is very fragile.

examples.hanzi: 她看起来很坚强，其实内心很脆弱。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlai hěn jiānqiáng, qíshí nèixīn hěn cuìruò.
examples.english: She looks strong, but she's actually fragile inside.

examples.hanzi: 我每天都吃一点水果。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān dōu chī yìdiǎn shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: I eat some fruit every day.

examples.hanzi: 你想吃什么水果？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme shuǐguǒ?
examples.english: What fruit would you like to eat?

examples.hanzi: 这家店的服务很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de fúwù hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This shop's service is very good.

examples.hanzi: 这家公司明年要招聘新员工。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī míngnián yào zhāopìn xīn yuángōng.
examples.english: This company will recruit new employees next year.

examples.hanzi: 他在局里工作了二十年。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài jú lǐ gōngzuò le èrshí nián.
examples.english: He has worked in the bureau for twenty years.

examples.hanzi: 局里明天开会，请大家准时参加。
examples.pinyin: Jú lǐ míngtiān kāihuì, qǐng dàjiā zhǔnshí cānjiā.
examples.english: The bureau has a meeting tomorrow; please attend on time.
